name: Feeding the Silkworms
summary: This painting is from an album depicting the silk industry. Silkworms are reared in mats made of rush or bamboo. The mats are rectangular in shape and are usually stacked in tiers in a wooden stand. The silkworms need to be fed as much as possible before they get ready to shed their skins.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
